title: Create an iCore Python Microservice (FastAPI / gRPC)

name.description: Microservice name in kebab-case (e.g. ml-inference, embeddings, webhooks).
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the Python microservice?

framework.description: Python server framework to scaffold (fastapi over HTTP or grpc over HTTP/2).

x-prompt.message: Which Python framework would you like to use?

items.label: FastAPI (HTTP REST + OpenAPI + Axios BFF client)

port.description: Port for the Python microservice (auto-incremented from existing services if omitted).

uvWorkspace.description: Register apps/microservices/<name> in root pyproject.toml [tool.uv.workspace] members.

skipBff.description: Skip generating libs/<name>-client and wiring the service into apps/api.

tags.description: Comma-separated extra Nx tags to append to default tags (type:microservice, lang:python, scope:<name>).
